buttons.outline: border-2 border-[#0F5132] text-[#0F5132] rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium hover:bg-[#F9F8F6] transition-colors

heatmap.container: grid grid-cols-6 gap-2 (1 for row labels, 5 for days)
heatmap.cell: aspect-square rounded-md flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-medium transition-colors

tables.header: border-b border-[#E2E8E5] bg-[#F9F8F6] px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-[#7A8A82]

landing_page.hero: Two-column layout on desktop. Left: Large Playfair Display heading, body text explaining the demand study, Primary and Outline CTA buttons. Right: Rounded image of campus/students or shuttle bus with subtle green overlay or border. Add a small 'Exclusive to verified @std.ewubd.edu' badge above the heading.
landing_page.features: Three-column grid below hero. Cards with icon (Bus, Clock, Dollar). Flat design, generous padding, minimal text.

survey_wizard.layout: Center-aligned narrow container (max-w-2xl) to keep focus. Use the progress bar at the top.
survey_wizard.email_step: Input must validate against the regex ^\d{4}-\d-\d{2}-\d{3}@std\.ewubd\.edu$.
survey_wizard.route_step: Display routes as selectable cards. If a non-Chashara route is selected, show a friendly 'We will contact you soon' dead-end state.
survey_wizard.days_step: Grid of 5 selectable cards (Sunday to Thursday).
survey_wizard.trips_step: For each selected day, show available Up/Down times.
survey_wizard.payment_step: Dynamic pricing calculation based on one-way or round-trip and Monthly vs Semester.
survey_wizard.fare_negotiation: A toggle/radio for 'I agree' or 'I want cheaper'. If cheaper, reveal a numeric input field.

admin_dashboard.layout: Sidebar with navigation and Month filter. Top right: Global Start/Stop survey toggle.
admin_dashboard.kpi_section: Bento grid with 4 metric cards: Total Respondents, Revenue, Avg Seat Occupancy (calculated against 36 capacity), Peak Trip time.
admin_dashboard.charts_section: Use Recharts for Bar (Day-wise demand), Line (Trip-wise demand), and Pie (Route demand).
admin_dashboard.heatmap_section: Matrix of Days (Sun-Thu) vs Trips (Up/Down). Shade cells dynamically based on respondent count.
admin_dashboard.ai_forecast: Place prominently in a wider card (col-span-full or half). Use Claude Sonnet 5 as mock data source, format with glowing edge or distinct layout.
admin_dashboard.data_table: List survey responses. Implement visual highlight (pink background) if is_test_data is true.

hero_bus.description: Green/White university shuttle bus to be used in the hero or feature section.

campus_students.description: Students walking on campus, can be used for trust building or feature cards.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT use Inter, Roboto, or standard Tailwind sans fonts for headings. Use Playfair Display.
Do NOT center align everything. Keep dense forms and dashboards left-aligned for scannability.
Use 2-3x more spacing than default. Apply p-6 or p-8 to cards, and py-16 to sections.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays or navs. Use bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl.
Implement motion using Framer Motion for wizard step transitions (fade in/out, slide up).
For the Admin Dashboard, do not overuse cards. Keep the UI dense but structured with 1px borders (#E2E8E5) and no shadows.
Include 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, selectable cards).
